cmdl.hint: Command or alias (W, L, M, RO), point #x;y, @dx;dy, d<angle. Ctrl+J: ask the AI assistant
cmdl.hint_ai: Ask the AI assistant about the model or for a change. Ctrl+J: back to commands
cmdl.no_tool: Start a drawing command first, then type its points
cmdl.unknown: No command “{text}”. Ctrl+J sends it to the AI assistant
cmdl.shape: “{text}” is not a point: type x;y, #x;y, @dx;dy or a positive distance<angle
